title: Homeschooling Stayed Nearly Double After Schools Reopened
hook: Schools reopened, but homeschooling stayed at 5.4 percent.
closing: Reopened classrooms did not undo families' new education choices.
question: What matters most when choosing school?

segments.say: Homeschooling settled at 5.4 percent, still nearly double its pre-pandemic share.
School environment or safety concerned 83 percent of homeschooling parents, making it the leading reported reason.
Private schooling held 9.6 percent, so homeschooling remained the smaller alternative.
